about: The signature features: what makes SecuRAX recognisable and loved. Principle signature-perfect (owner, 2026-11-14): each is held to perfection in every aspect below, and a test proves it. Add a feature here when it becomes distinctive; never remove one without the owner.
bar: meaning at a glance: useful, not decoration; one tap explains it
a material true to nature (measured optics, natural palette), used sparingly
motion from physics (springs, orbits, damping), calm: it settles, it never nags
every device and both themes, the empty, partial and complete states all finished
accessible: a label for screen readers, keyboard, reduced motion, contrast
light on the device: drawn only when it changes, cached, a fallback without the GPU

features.name: The night-sky lock
features.nature: stars by magnitude and colour, the Milky Way, a density-wave spiral galaxy, meteors, a comet

features.name: The gold seal
features.nature: guilloche sunray under blue enamel, polished gold, a Tolkowsky brilliant in platinum

features.name: Lit gold, platinum and velvet
features.nature: measured metal reflectance, velvet sheen, light that follows the hand

features.name: Jade keycaps
features.nature: jade, a mechanical key with travel and a tick
